versions.changelog:
Initial release: Enables users to draw Alibaba Cloud architecture diagrams through CADT AI agent using the Aliyun CLI.

- Accepts resource/product descriptions and submits them to the CADT backend for automated architecture generation.
- Supports multi-turn conversations, including clarifying questions from the AI agent.
- Requires session reuse: user-provided `sessionId` must always be used for follow-ups.
- All results are relayed via Markdown summary; no local diagram generation.
- Strict error handling, polling, and security rules to ensure reliability and privacy.
- Fully CLI-based workflow with mandatory user-agent tagging for observability.
